The '''2018 Minnesota Happy Halloween Tournament''' was a four-game Swiss event held on 27 October 2018 at Level Up Games in Eagan, Minnesota, organized by [[Mark Walseth]]. Players earned prize tickets for wins and for deploying creatures and having them eat characters or starships. [[Jim Li|Jim]] went undefeated; [[Charlie Arlandson|Charlie A.]] won the top prize, a LEGO TIE Fighter, in the ticket draw.<ref name="hal18">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=70632 Minnesota - Happy Halloween Tournament 2018 (Oct. 27th)], forum.starwarsccg.org (27 September – 15 November 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004956/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t70632.html Internet Archive]</ref>
